title: scenarios: the citation grader rejects a source line that names a multi-word object by its label ("Source: Invoice Line")
body:
epic:#5027#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMUfmNYTem26rXLFUf

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named landing point and a reproduction. Source: epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5027. The cloud#5031 baseline thread found it on 2026-11-26 by reading the tool outputs and the scorer source at objectstack `d5ae7a47`; `origin/main` has the same code.
Reader: seat `epic:#5027#1` (its territory covers `packages/qa/scenarios/**`); fence `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/namespace.ts` plus the grader that reads it, and their tests.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `citationLabels` and `citation grader`. No match.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：场景卡的「问数」评分里，每个数字要注明出处。评分器只认对象的英文短名（如 `invoice_line`）或带命名空间的全名；模型写「Source: Invoice Line」「Source: Expense Claim」这种多词标签就判成「没注明出处」。同一条回答，「Source: Invoice」算对，「Source: Invoice Line」算错。
- 影响：cloud#5031 基线里，发票卡每轮被错扣 5～6 分，差旅卡 4～7 分；Claude Code 和云端智能体两边都会被冤枉，对比数字失真。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Reproduction
- `runner/namespace.ts:133` `citationLabels` maps `${ns}_${name}` to `[name]`, the card's snake_case short name only. The grader accepts a source line only if it holds the namespaced API name or one of those labels.
- The framework MCP `aggregate` / `query` outputs carry no `sourceLine`; only `query_dataset` does. So the model writes the label itself, as the user sees it.
- Same reply, two grades (cloud#5031 rows):
  - "Source: Invoice" is cited; "Source: Invoice Line" is uncited.
  - "Source: Expense Claim (demotravel_expense_claim)" is cited; "Source: Expense Claim" is uncited.
- Regraded by hand: invoice `问数` 16, 13, 16 instead of 11, 8, 10; travel_expense 12, 13, 11 (before) and 10, 10, 11 (main).

## What to do
1. `citationLabels` also accepts, for each object, the de-underscored short name (`invoice line`, case-insensitive) and the object's served label as the booted app declares it (the card's object label, or `describe_object`'s `label`).
2. Keep the match conservative. A label must appear in the source line, not anywhere in the reply. A line naming a different object must still fail. Test both.
3. A changeset for `@objectstack/scenarios`. Re-scoring old recordings is the eval thread's job, not this card's.

## Acceptance
- A unit test over the three reply shapes above, plus a wrong-object control.
- The cloud#5031 thread re-scores its recordings with the fixed grader and gets the hand-regraded numbers.

Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `citationLabels` was introduced with scenario namespacing; the bare-name allowance was meant to cover exactly this, but only for one-word objects.
Suggested-grade: p1 · the epic's baseline numbers depend on it.
